reg_encoding: four little-endian uint64 values: write-channel base/size, restart-reason base/size
requires: Successful redfin_spmi_probe() in this boot, PON subtype4, APIDownerEE0, cpus=1 and other PMIC clients disabled. No automatic call is installed.
effects: One masked SID0/PON0x088f byte update, verified through observer readback; then IMEM bootloader magic with readback. Does not issue reset.
notice: Preparation only; bootloader return after watchdog still requires the controlled hardware test. No PSHOLD, PHY, SMMU, IRQ clear, EDL or partition writes.
